# PARADA

> PARADA is a mobile and web-based smart parking management system using computer vision, license-plate recognition, and zone-based occupancy monitoring. Built as an academic capstone project at Lyceum of the Philippines University — Batangas.

- [Experience](https://parada.lorenzmalabanan.com/): The capstone's final-defense deck over a 3D model of LPU-Batangas: the parking problem, prior sensor-based work, why PARADA counts at zone gates, objectives, scope, methods, the arrival-to-receipt trip, and the Phase 14 evaluation results.
- [Technical overview](https://parada.lorenzmalabanan.com/technical/): Architecture, features, configuration, stack, security, and build status.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/E1yWrites/parada): Source code.
